in_sanskrit.name: कांकण
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has beautiful eyes (Kanj) or the one who adorns with her beauty (Shoba).

in_hindi.name: कांकण
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who has beautiful eyes (Kankana) or the one who is the source of happiness (Kanj).

in_tamil.name: காங்கன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who has beautiful eyes (Kangan) or the one who is the center of attraction (Kizham).

in_telugu.name: కాంగణ్ణ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who has beautiful eyes (Kangan) or the one who is a source of happiness and prosperity (Shobhapathi).

in_marathi.name: Kankan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kankan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kankan is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Kankana', which refers to the Goddess Kali. The name symbolizes power, strength, and protection. In Hindu mythology, Goddess Kali is depicted as the goddess of time, creation, preservation, and destruction.
